verdicts.reason: A breaks the left grid: the quote mark (x≈55) and the attribution (x≈48) don't line up with the headline (x≈26). The attribution is jammed under the last headline line and sits on the top edge of the circle, and the centred circle swallows the logo, so the original's corner placement is lost. B keeps the quote mark, headline, attribution and logo on one shared left edge and puts the circle and can in the lower right like the original, but the headline ends on a one-word last line ('soon.') and the can feels small and crowded against the right edge.
